title: In My Game You MUST Take Care of Mental Health of Your Colonists!
author: devbblue
selftext:
I am making voxel based open world life simulation multiplayer game.

Check out the demo on Steam! (soon to be available, waiting for execution file approval)  
Wishlist it now!  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5400970/Forever\_World\_Craft/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5400970/Forever_World_Craft/)

Be part of the development by joining the community!  
[https://discord.gg/QUH4UEg6eH](https://discord.gg/QUH4UEg6eH)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/devbblue please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: devbblue
replies.body: done, this is a vibe coded game, so a lot of it is really AI generated

comments.author: Honest_Accident_8348
comments.body: Yeah.. su*cide isn’t really funny.. sorry but I think it’s pretty poor taste

replies.author: devbblue
replies.body: I come from South Korea, a country with the highest suicide rate in the world. For us suicide is a real issue and I would like to implement it as a game mechanic and make a gameplay around taking care of one's mental health.

replies.author: xoexohexox
replies.body: Korea's also got one of the lowest fertility rates in the world why don't you make a game about makin' babies it'll sell more

replies.author: devbblue
replies.body: If making money was truly my ultimate goal I would not be here making game lol

replies.author: HaMMeReD
replies.body: Maybe so, but English probably isn't the demographic if you want to market it like this. Topics of suicide in a game are fine with a disclosure, front and center as a gag in a trailer, bad taste.

replies.author: Honest_Accident_8348
replies.body:
Ok, but it doesn’t come off that way.  The trailer, with an adorably animated character hanging themselves with a little smile is just yuck.  
You could make a game about taking care of the characters metal health without that.  
You posted for opinions, so that’s mine.

replies.author: ChadSexman
replies.body:
You really need to figure out how to do it tastefully or remove the mechanic entirely.

Using it as a trailer gag is pretty damn gross dude, and not in an “interesting gross” way, just a socially “wtf is wrong with the person who made this” kinda way.

replies.author: Nice_Function4963
replies.body: Its also a video game but I get where youre coming from. If its bad taste for you, just might not be the target audience. Its a brash concept but I like the freedom of the idea

comments.author: Ferniclestix
comments.body:
i cant even manage my own mental health let alone some needy colonists.   


I could see it in a dark grimdark horror survival colony situation (im writing a book like that actually lol mine has cannibalism muahhaha)  anyway, i just cant really see it in a game with kid level graphics, it seems wrong somehow to me.

These themes are dificult to talk about and anyone who has actually attempted it before will tell you this,  it doesnt just come from being hungry or uncomfortable, it comes from deep seated cultural, social, health and mental issues which I doubt your game explores at least from the happy cartoony video you have posted.

as someone who has and knows people who have attempted it. I would advise aginst this concept. im actually surprised you got it on steam.

comments.author: jimbojohndoe
comments.body:
This art style with this theme, reviewing from the video, seems countering each other. That's what it seems like. 

Honestly, showcasing suicide really should be less, graphic? Like NPCs in games can work to their death because they are too sad and just spontaneously falling to their death or failing some kind of mechanism in a simulation, but I think the NPCs taking their own life by rope is going to leave a sour taste for players. Wrong game for it TBH. Not sure if you built this just to farm engagement?

comments.author: couldgiveaflyingfck
comments.body: Did I just see people hanging? Maybe I wasn't paying attention

replies.author: devbblue
replies.body: hahaha, yeah. Later they can be sometimes be revived as a ghost or zombie too
